report:
Normalization strips only ASCII spaces and tabs from line edges, preserving interior whitespace and every logical blank line including trailing blank lines. CRLF and bare CR become LF; empty input stays empty; nonempty output gains a terminating LF only if absent, with existing trailing LF preserved. Unicode receives no normalization. ([Normalization](wiki/pages/normalization.md), S001)

The utility reads exactly one file path and emits normalized UTF-8 to stdout. Invalid UTF-8, missing files and directory inputs exit 2 with concise stderr and no stdout. No in-place writes, stdin mode, size limit or external dependencies. ([Errors](wiki/pages/errors.md), S002)

Dependency entry identities, readiness status and prerequisite relationships are not covered by these wiki pages. Likely source to ingest separately: .specify/memory/roadmap.md; recommendation only, no ingestion authorized by this query.

Relied-on pages: wiki/pages/normalization.md (S001); wiki/pages/errors.md (S002).
Coverage: Partial.
